csv_project_name: PM for CAP Roof Replacement Program
csv_scope_of_work: The Central Arizona Water Conservation District (CAWCD), is soliciting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) for Program Manager for CAP Roof Replacement Program. The Program Manager ( PM ) shall function as an Owner s Representative and advisory consultant to CAWCD, working closely with CAWCD personnel to support the effective management and successful delivery of the project. Project design and execution will be carried out through a coordinated partnership between CAWCD and the PM. In this role, the PM shall provide program management, coordination, procurement support, technical advisory services, project controls, and quality oversight support to facilitate multiple roof replacement projects.
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Mechanical Engineering
